meta.name: lsp-setup
meta.description: Configure a Language Server (LSP) for a specific language so editor/agent tooling — diagnostics, go-to-definition, find-references, rename — works. Use when you need to: configure LSP, lsp setup, set up or install a language server, fix 'no LSP server configured' / 'server not installed', choose between servers (basedpyright vs pyright vs ty vs ruff), or wire .codex/lsp-client.json / .opencode/lsp.json. 언어서버 설정. Routes by file extension to references/<language>/README.md for the exact builtin server, per-OS install commands (macOS/Linux/Windows), config snippets for both config files, initialization options, alternatives, and troubleshooting. Ships scripts: detect-lsp.ts (scan a project for languages + each server's install/config status) and verify-lsp.ts (run a real diagnostics roundtrip). Covers typescript, python, go, rust, c/c++, java, kotlin, c#/razor, swift, ruby, php, dart, elixir, zig, lua, bash, yaml, terraform, haskell, julia.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为项目配置语言服务器，让代码诊断和跳转生效
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要为不同语言配置 LSP 或修复编辑器诊断功能
copy.tagline_en: Configure language servers for your project to enable code diagnostics and navigation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to set up or fix LSP for different languages in your editor

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按项目文件类型选定对应的语言服务器,负责安装、写入配置,并跑一次真实诊断验证;编辑器/代理的 LSP 功能(诊断、跳转定义、查找引用、重命名)就能工作。
howto.when: 当你说要配置或安装语言服务器、修复“未配置或未安装 LSP”报错、选择服务器等,或要写 LSP 配置文件时;它也会按文件扩展名自动识别语言。

say.text: 帮我在这个项目里配置 TypeScript 的语言服务器。
say.note: 会检测并安装合适的服务器。

say.text: 用 verify-lsp 检查 src/main.go 的诊断是否正常。
say.note: 跑真实诊断往返,返回 OK/FAIL。

howto.what_en: After setup, Claude will pick the right language server for a project's file types, install it, write config, and run a real diagnostics roundtrip so LSP features (diagnostics, go-to-definition, references, rename) work.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to configure/install a language server, fix 'no LSP server configured' or 'server not installed', choose between servers, or wire LSP config files; also routes by file extension.

say_en.text: Configure a TypeScript language server for this project.
say_en.note: It will detect and install the right server.

say_en.text: Fix the 'no LSP server configured' error; this project is Python.
say_en.note: It installs and writes config per the reference.

say_en.text: Run verify-lsp on src/main.go to check diagnostics.
say_en.note: Runs a real roundtrip and returns OK/FAIL.
